articles.subject: Cannot login to dashboard
articles.body:
Hi Support,

I've been trying to login to the dashboard for the past hour but keep getting an error message saying 'Invalid credentials' even though I'm sure my password is correct.

I tried resetting my password but the reset email never arrived.

Can you please help?

Thanks,
John

articles.subject: Re: Cannot login to dashboard
articles.body:
Hi John,

Thank you for reaching out! I'm looking into your account now.

I can see that your account was temporarily locked due to multiple failed login attempts. I've unlocked it for you.

Regarding the password reset email - I've checked our email logs and it appears the email was sent but may have been caught by your spam filter. Could you check your spam/junk folder?

Please try logging in again and let me know if you still have issues.

Best regards,
Sarah

articles.subject: Re: Cannot login to dashboard
articles.body:
Perfect! I was able to login successfully. Found the reset email in spam as you suggested.

Thank you for the quick help!

John

articles.subject: API rate limit too restrictive
articles.body:
Hello,

We're building an integration with your API but keep hitting the rate limit of 100 requests/minute. For our use case, we need to sync data for thousands of users every hour.

Is there a way to increase our rate limit? We're on the Business plan.

Technical details:
- Current limit: 100 req/min
- Our requirement: ~500 req/min
- Use case: User data synchronization
- Plan: Business (annual)

Please advise on next steps.

Thanks,
Mike

articles.subject: Request demo for Enterprise plan
articles.body:
Hi Sales Team,

We're currently on the Professional plan but our team is growing quickly. I'd like to schedule a demo of the Enterprise plan to understand:

1. Advanced security features
2. SSO integration options
3. Custom SLA support
4. Dedicated support channels

Our team size will be ~200 users by Q1 2025.

Could someone reach out to schedule a demo?

Best,
John Customer
IT Director, Acme Corporation

tickets.title: Data export feature crashes with large datasets
tickets.note: Critical bug affecting data export functionality

articles.subject: Data export feature crashes with large datasets
articles.body:
Hi Engineering Team,

We've encountered a critical bug when trying to export data. When we attempt to export more than 10,000 records, the export feature crashes and shows a 500 error.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Navigate to Data Export page
2. Select 'All Records' filter (results in >10k records)
3. Click 'Export to CSV'
4. Browser shows 'Server Error 500'

Expected: Export should complete or show pagination
Actual: Complete failure with error 500

This is blocking our quarterly reporting. Please prioritize.

Browser: Chrome 118
Plan: Business
Dataset size: ~25,000 records

Thanks,
Mike

tickets.title: Email notifications not being sent
tickets.note: Bug report - email notification system failure

articles.subject: Email notifications not being sent
articles.body:
Hello Support,

Since yesterday evening (Oct 2, ~7pm EST), none of our users are receiving email notifications from the platform.

Affected notifications:
- Welcome emails for new users
- Password reset emails
- Activity notifications
- Weekly summary emails

We've checked:
- Spam folders - nothing there
- Email settings in user profiles - all enabled
- SMTP configuration - appears correct

This is affecting all 150 users in our organization. No emails have been received since the issue started.

Can you investigate urgently?

Regards,
John Customer

tickets.title: Mobile app login fails on iOS 17
tickets.note: iOS 17 compatibility issue with mobile authentication

articles.subject: Mobile app login fails on iOS 17
articles.body:
Hi Team,

After updating to iOS 17, several of our team members can't log into the mobile app. The login button just spins indefinitely and eventually times out with 'Network Error'.

Device info:
- iPhone 14 Pro, iOS 17.0.3
- iPhone 15, iOS 17.1
- iPad Pro, iOS 17.0.2

All affected devices:
- Updated to iOS 17 in the last week
- Can login successfully via web browser
- Mobile app version 2.8.1 (latest from App Store)
- Have tried reinstalling the app
- Have stable WiFi and cellular connections

Web login works fine, only mobile app is affected.

Please investigate this iOS 17 compatibility issue.

Thanks,
Mike Developer
